gloss: male and female; the sexes; victory or defeat

definitions.gloss: male and female (of animals and plants)
definitions.explanation: The two sexes of an animal or plant, taken together. A written, scientific word; for people, {男女|だんじょ} is used.
Figuratively, which side wins, chiefly in the idiom {雌雄|しゆう}を{決|けっ}する, to fight a decisive battle.

examples.japanese: {雌雄|しゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧

examples.english: In this fish, the male and the female differ in color.
The ginkgo has separate male and female trees, and only the female trees bear fruit.

examples.japanese: {雌雄|しゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{決|けっ}する。
⟦{両軍|りょうぐん}→両軍：32009_ryougun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついに{雌雄|しゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{決|けっ}することになった。
examples.english: The two armies were at last to fight a decisive battle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雌雄|しゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{決|けっ}する。
examples.english: In the final, longtime rivals will settle who is the better team.

notes:
{雌|し} is female and {雄|ゆう} male; the same kanji read め and お appear in ⟦{雌|めす}→雌：11243_mesu⟧ and ⟦{雄|おす}→雄：10732_osu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雌雄|しゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{決|けっ}する: to fight a decisive battle; to settle who wins
- {雌雄|しゆう}{同体|どうたい}: hermaphroditic (snails, earthworms)
- {雌雄|しゆう}{異株|いしゅ}: dioecious, with separate male and female plants
- {雌雄|しゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: one can tell male from female
